data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: bread
sections.question: bread
sections.summary: a food made from flour, water, and yeast, mixed and baked in an oven

senses.definition: a common food made from flour, water, and usually yeast mixed together and then baked
examples: She bought a fresh loaf of bread from the bakery this morning.
He eats bread and butter for breakfast every day.

answers.answer: She bought a fresh loaf of bread from the bakery this morning.
He drank a warm cup of bread before going to bed.
She poured the bread into a glass and drank it quickly.
He grew bread in his garden all summer long.

sections.title: breakfast
sections.question: breakfast
sections.summary: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning

senses.definition: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
examples: She always has a bowl of cereal for breakfast before going to school.
He cooked eggs and toast for breakfast on Saturday morning.

answers.answer: She has a bowl of cereal and a glass of juice for breakfast every morning.
He had breakfast at midnight when he came home very late.
She made breakfast in the bathroom before leaving for work.
The restaurant served breakfast at three o'clock in the afternoon.

sections.title: coffee
sections.question: coffee
sections.summary: a hot drink made from roasted coffee beans, or a cup of this drink

senses.definition: a hot drink made from ground roasted coffee beans, or a cup of this drink
examples: She drinks two cups of coffee every morning to help her wake up.
He ordered a coffee and a sandwich at the café.

answers.answer: She made a cup of coffee and sat down to read the newspaper.
He ate a large bowl of hot coffee for his breakfast.
She put coffee on her toast every morning instead of butter.
He cooked the coffee in the oven for thirty minutes at 200 degrees.

sections.title: dinner
sections.question: dinner
sections.summary: the main meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening

senses.definition: the main meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening
examples: The family sat down together for dinner at seven o'clock.
She cooked a big dinner for all the family on Sunday.

answers.answer: The family sat down together for dinner at seven o'clock in the evening.
She ate dinner at six o'clock in the morning before going to school.
He cooked dinner in the bathroom while his wife set the table.
She had dinner in a glass with some ice and a straw.

sections.title: fish
sections.question: fish
sections.summary: an animal that lives in water, or the flesh of this animal used as food

senses.definition: an animal that lives and swims in water and breathes through gills
examples: She saw many colourful fish swimming in the sea.
He keeps tropical fish in a large tank in his living room.

senses.definition: the flesh of a fish used as food
examples: She cooked fish and vegetables for dinner on Friday evening.
He ordered grilled fish and chips at the restaurant.

answers.answer: She cooked fish and vegetables for dinner on Friday evening.
He drank a cold glass of fresh fish after his long run.
She put fish in her coffee to make it taste better.
He planted fish in the garden to grow food for the winter.

sections.title: fruit
sections.question: fruit
sections.summary: the sweet part of a plant that contains seeds and can be eaten

senses.definition: the part of a plant that contains seeds and can be eaten, usually sweet
examples: She eats a piece of fruit every day to stay healthy.
Apples, bananas, and oranges are all types of fruit.

answers.answer: She eats fresh fruit every day to stay healthy.
He drinks fresh fruit every morning instead of cereal.
She poured fruit into the kettle to make a hot drink.
He grew fruit in a glass of water on the kitchen table.

sections.title: juice
sections.question: juice
sections.summary: the liquid that comes from fruit or vegetables

senses.definition: the liquid that comes from fruit or vegetables, or a glass of this
examples: She drank a glass of orange juice with her breakfast.
He makes fresh juice every morning using apples and carrots.

answers.answer: She drank a glass of orange juice with her breakfast.
He ate a large plate of juice for lunch with some bread.
She cooked juice in the oven for twenty minutes until it was ready.
He spread juice on his toast every morning instead of jam.

sections.title: lunch
sections.question: lunch
sections.summary: a meal eaten in the middle of the day

senses.definition: a meal eaten in the middle of the day
examples: She usually has a sandwich and some fruit for lunch at work.
He met his friend for lunch at a café in the city centre.

answers.answer: She usually has a sandwich and some fruit for lunch at work.
He ate lunch at midnight when he came home from the party.
She made lunch in the bathroom before going to the office.
He drank his lunch from a big mug and added two spoons of sugar.

sections.title: meat
sections.question: meat
sections.summary: the flesh of an animal or bird eaten as food

senses.definition: the flesh of an animal or bird that is eaten as food
examples: She cooked meat and potatoes for dinner on Sunday.
He doesn't eat meat because he is a vegetarian.

answers.answer: She cooked meat and vegetables for the family on Sunday afternoon.
He poured meat into his coffee cup to make a warm morning drink.
She drank a large bowl of cold meat after her swimming lesson.
He grew meat in his garden next to the carrots and tomatoes.

sections.title: milk
sections.question: milk
sections.summary: a white liquid produced by cows or other animals that people drink and use in cooking

senses.definition: a white liquid produced by cows, goats, and other animals that people drink and use in cooking
examples: She pours milk into her cereal every morning before school.
He adds milk and sugar to his tea.

answers.answer: She pours milk over her cereal every morning before going to school.
He ate a large piece of cold milk for his afternoon snack.
She cooked milk in the oven for an hour until it turned golden brown.
He spread cold milk on his toast every morning instead of butter.
